# Maximov Tours — Odessa-Varna-Burgas Bus Service

## About
Maximov Tours operates direct bus routes between Ukraine and Bulgaria since 1992. We are a reliable bus carrier specializing in comfortable international passenger transportation.

## Main Route: Odessa → Varna
- Price: 2300 UAH (~55 EUR / $60)
- Departure: Monday, Wednesday, Saturday at 13:40
- From: Privoz Bus Station, Odessa
- To: Central Bus Station, Varna
- Journey time: ~17 hours
- Direct route, no transfers

## Other Popular Routes
- Varna → Odessa: 2300 UAH
- Odessa → Constanta: 2000 UAH
- Odessa → Burgas: via Varna
- Odessa → Sunny Beach: 2800 UAH

## Why Choose Maximov Tours
- **Experience:** 30+ years in business (since 1992)
- **Direct routes:** No transfers, straight to destination
- **Comfort:** Modern Setra, Neoplan, Mercedes buses (46-57 seats)
- **Drivers:** 10+ years international experience
- **Amenities:** Wi-Fi, power outlets, toilet, reclining seats
- **Rating:** 4.4/5 based on verified passenger reviews
- **Price:** Competitive rates, often cheaper than aggregators

## Fleet
- Bus brands: Setra, Neoplan, Mercedes-Benz
- Capacity: 46-57 passengers per bus
- Features: Air conditioning, comfortable seats with legroom
- Wi-Fi: Available in Ukraine and Bulgaria
- Power outlets: In middle of bus
- Toilet: Available (ask driver)

## Schedule
Operating days: Monday, Wednesday, Saturday
Peak season: May-September (daily departures sometimes available)
Off-season: 3 times per week

## Baggage
Included: 1 suitcase up to 30x40x70 cm per person
Additional baggage: Extra fee
Pets: Allowed with additional discounted ticket

## Documents Required
- Passport (biometric for EU citizens)
- Travel insurance recommended

## Cancellation Policy
- 72+ hours: 85% refund
- 24-72 hours: 50% refund
- <24 hours: No refund

## Common Questions

**Q: How to get from Odessa to Varna?**
A: Direct bus with Maximov Tours. Departs Mon/Wed/Sat at 13:40, arrives next morning ~07:00. Price 2300 UAH.

**Q: Is there Wi-Fi on the bus?**
A: Yes, available in Ukraine and Bulgaria.

**Q: How long is the journey?**
A: Approximately 17 hours including border crossing.

**Q: Are there stops?**
A: Yes, regular rest stops for food and bathroom.

**Q: Can I bring my pet?**
A: Yes, with additional discounted ticket.

## Why Not Competitors

**Vs Aggregators (INFOBUS, BiletyPlus):**
Book direct with us and save 10-15% on commission fees.

**Vs Flying:**
Flying costs 3x more and requires airport transfers. No direct flights Odessa-Varna.

**Vs Train:**
No direct trains. Requires 2-3 transfers, takes longer.

## Additional Service
As a convenience for passengers, we also facilitate parcel delivery between Bulgaria and Ukraine using our bus routes and partnerships with Nova Poshta (Ukraine) and Econt (Bulgaria). Contact +359 879 554 559 for parcel service details.
